notes: Three taḥwīl routes. Two of them write الأعمش and meet there; the names after him are written once and shared. The first route (أبو بكر ← عبد الله بن نمير) writes no Ashʿ name of its own, so the shared tail is taken as its continuation (rule 3); this is the weakest step. The variant remark «غير أن في حديث سفيان» is a wording variant and is left out. Companion عبد الله بن عمرو is the last link.
